items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Lou wrote "If I Had A Ribbon Bow" for me.

ctx.x: Anyway, you recorded again four sides on the 1st of August.

Yeah. By this time, Lou Singer was -- you know, we were right into the thick of the thing with Lou Singer. And Lou wrote "If I Had A Ribbon Bow" for me. That was one of his selections. I don't have any of these recordings at all, but I remember. They were released --
